password.tooShort: The password must have at least 8 characters.
password.tooLong: The password can have at most 72 characters.

forgot.title: Recover password
forgot.help: Enter your email and we will send a link to create a new password.
forgot.sent: If this email has an account, we sent the recovery link. It is valid for 30 minutes.

reset.title: Create new password
reset.done: Password changed. Sign in with your new password.

pitch.month: Record fixed costs, card spending and income for each month.
pitch.closings: See how much you spent at each closing of the month.
pitch.noBank: No bank connection: you write it down and Nize does the math.

onboarding.title: Welcome to Nize, {{name}}!
onboarding.intro: In a few steps you start tracking your month.

steps.log: Add your fixed expenses, card expenses and income on the month screen.
steps.position: See your balance and how much you spent in each part of the month (by default: day 1 to 15 and 16 to the end).
steps.setup: Adjust categories, cards and people whenever you like, under Categories, Cards and People.

errors.nameTooLong: The name can have at most 80 characters.
errors.descriptionTooLong: The description can have at most 255 characters.
errors.limit: Enter an amount above zero or leave it empty.

categories.deleteQuestion: Delete the category "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.
categories.inUse_one: The category "{{name}}" has {{count}} expense and cannot be deleted.
categories.inUse_other: The category "{{name}}" has {{count}} expenses and cannot be deleted.
categories.inUseQuestion: Do you want to change those expenses first? The category stays as it is.

cards.empty: No cards this year. Add yours to record credit expenses.
cards.deleteQuestion: Delete the card "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.
cards.inUse_one: The card "{{name}}" is used by {{count}} expense, so it cannot be deleted.
cards.inUse_other: The card "{{name}}" is used by {{count}} expenses, so it cannot be deleted.
cards.inUseQuestion: Change the card of those expenses or deactivate the card. It stays as it is.

people.empty: No people this year. Add whoever uses your card, like your mother.

brand.title: Select card
brand.required: Select a card or add a new one.
brand.noMatch: No card found. Use "Add a new card".
brand.notice: Names and logos belong to their owners and only help you recognise your cards.

settings.currentYearHelp: The year that opens by default on the screens.
settings.autoInstallmentsHelp: When you record an installment purchase, Nize creates one installment per month.
settings.newYearHelp: Creates the year so you can enter its months. Categories, cards and people are the same in every year.
settings.closingsHelp: Shows on the month screen the sum of the expenses of each period up to the chosen day. A day past the end of the month counts as the last day.
settings.invalidClosingDay: Enter a day from 1 to 31 that is not in the list yet.

expense.title: New expense
expense.fixedHelp: It also goes into the next months, including the ones you already opened. Making it not fixed takes it out of the next months.

errors.name: Enter a name.
errors.amount: Enter an amount above zero, like 49.90.
errors.manualCount: Enter the total installments, from 2 to 120.
errors.manualNumber: The current installment must be between 1 and the total.
errors.card: Choose a card or create a new one.

expense.installmentFixed: Installment {{label}}: the type and the installments do not change when editing.

income.title: New income
income.installmentFixed: Installment {{label}}: the installments do not change when editing.

installments.title: Installments
installments.help: With automatic installments on, the next installments show up when you open the following months.

summary.title: Summaries

summary.byPerson: Third parties by person and card
